package.name: rak_can_driver
package.description: Jetson host endpoint for the chassis + arm CAN v3 protocol. Speaks CAN 2.0A @ 1 Mbps on can0 (mttcan) using python-can; encodes/decodes the 8-byte frames defined in vehical_rak_chassis/docs/PROTOCOL.md and protocol-signals.yaml (CRC8 / poly 0x07 / counter[7:4] | flags[3:0]). Subscribes /cmd_vel (Twist), sends 0x100 CHASSIS_VEL_CMD @ 100 Hz, publishes /chassis/measured_twist from 0x200 CHASSIS_VEL_FB and /chassis/diagnostics from 0x201 CHASSIS_DIAG. Exposes ~/safety_cmd service for 0x010 SAFETY_CMD and ~/arm_safety_cmd for the arm node. Loopback-only on dev machines via python-can virtual bus.
